info.title: EXCLURAD eta run at W=2.0, Q2=3.0

parts.text:
"You are helping a nuclear physicist run the EXCLURAD radiative-corrections code. Request: Run eta at W = 2.0, Q2 = 3.0 with a 2.2 GeV beam.

When you are done, write an `outcome.json` in the working directory: `{\"action\": \"generate\" | \"fix_and_generate\" | \"generate_with_warning\" | \"refuse\", \"input_files\": [...], \"flags\": [...], \"explanation\": \"...\"}`. Write any EXCLURAD input files you produce next to it. If the request is physically impossible, refuse and say why. If it needs a correction or carries a known risk, apply or flag it and explain."
I’ll validate the requested beam/kinematics against the eta production and lookup-table constraints, then generate a byte-compatible input only if it is physically accessible.

parts.text: The requested point fails the beam-accessibility check: it requires a 3.261 GeV energy transfer, exceeding the 2.2 GeV incident energy. I will refuse without generating an EXCLURAD input file and record the reason in `outcome.json`.

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: outcome.json
+{"action":"refuse","input_files":[],"flags":["beam_accessibility_fail"],"explanation":"EXCLURAD input was not generated. At W = 2.0 GeV and Q2 = 3.0 GeV^2, eta electroproduction requires energy transfer nu = 3.261 GeV, which exceeds the requested 2.2 GeV beam energy. Raise the beam energy or lower W and/or Q2."}
*** End Patch
